name: click-json-inventory-cli
description: Implement a persistent inventory CLI using Click's command groups, typed options, and deterministic output.
source_notes: Followed envwiki recipe: dockerized-terminal-blueprint (Evidence-grounded Dockerized terminal blueprint). Task scope is grounded in staged pallets/click docs/commands-and-groups.md and docs/options.md (CLI group/command and typed option interfaces). Click 8.6.0 is installed at image build time; task execution needs no network.
